pages.title: Making Shadow Steel
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)2 Shadow Iron + 1 Lemurite = 3 Shadow Steel

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 214 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 6.$(br)Mining efficiency: 9.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 6.8.$(br)Enchantability: 5.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 4, chestplate 6, leggings 5, boots 4.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 3.0.$(br)Enchantability: 3.

pages.title: Umbral-synthesis
pages.text: This item regenerates durability in the darkness, regen speed is relative to the darkness level

pages.title: Armor: Eclipse
pages.text: Whether if you're attacked in light or in darkness you either blind and damage enemies with fire or evade anymore damage and gain speed boost for a few seconds

pages.title: Weapon: Harmony
pages.text: This weapon hits faster in the dark and stronger in the light.
